parole.testo: From Mongolian ᠰᠠᠭᠠᠳᠠᠭ (saɣadaɣ), from Proto-Mongolic *saxadag (“a bow-case, quiver”). Cognate of Azerbaijani sadaq, Bashkir һаҙаҡ (haðaq), Kalmyk саадг (saadg), Kazakh садақ (sadaq), Kyrgyz саадак (saadak), Southern Altai саадак (saadak), Turkmen sagdak, and Uzbek sadoq.

parole.significato: halter made of rope or chain
parole.testo: Inherited from Ottoman Turkish جلبور (çılbur, çulbur), ultimately from Mongolian чылбур (čylbur) ~ чулбуур (čulbuur). A Mongolic loan in the Turkic languages, compare Tatar чылбыр (çılbır).
From Ottoman Turkish اوڭدول (öñdül) from Mongolian [Term?] (“given thing”) via contamination with the verb ödemek (“to pay”).
